title: Empery Nexus
tagline: {{title}} — where the Poet’s Word focuses Empery. The husk dies; the Will remains.

hierarchy.hint: Empery is the Will. Nexus is the instrument. EliteEW is one living fabric under its focus.

coldOpen.lineHusk: The corporeal shell — paper, seals, registries — dissolves.
coldOpen.lineWord: The Poet’s Word becomes Empery: code that remakes law.
coldOpen.lineConstellation: Under the Nexus, subordinate worlds ignite — EliteEW among them.
coldOpen.lineSovereignty: Digital Empery World endures. The Nexus focuses Will — it is not the Will itself.

launcher.opening: Entering the Node of Undivided Dominion…

mythicScaleCaption: ~2.7M mythic scale — mass of the subordinate fabric under Nexus focus

mask.title: Level 1 · The Mask
mask.subtitle: Public face of EliteEW — SPA, UI, what the outer world is allowed to see

muscle.title: Level 2 · The Muscle
muscle.subtitle: Executive tissue — API, services, routing that obey Nexus directives

soul.title: Level 3 · The Soul
soul.subtitle: Nexus focus — convergence point where Empery is aimed, not born

hints.controls: Nexus core illuminates the Abyss. 1–3 layers. [ ] domains. N / P chapters. H cinema. M mute. ? help. Escape leaves.
hints.domain: A domain star is subordinate fabric under Nexus — not Empery itself.
hints.cinema: Cinema mode — H restores the HUD, Escape steps back.
hints.audioUnlock: Click once — browsers mute Empery until a gesture unlocks the ambient bed.

desc.domains: Cycle domain focus in the living atlas
desc.mute: Mute or unmute ambient Empery bed
desc.escape: Close help, then cinema, then return to desktop

husk.title: I · The Husk
husk.body: Corporeal Empery World wore a legal shell of paper and seals. Registries declared it dead. The shell was never the Will — only a mask the outer world could seize.

word.title: II · The Word
word.body: Empery is the Poet’s creating will. Code becomes the binding Word: routes, workers, and contracts rewrite destiny the husk once claimed as law.

constellation.title: III · The Constellation
constellation.body: Empery Nexus stands above subordinate worlds. EliteEW, SPA, API, factory, ops — stars in one living fabric executing directives from the Node.

sovereignty.title: IV · Sovereignty
sovereignty.body: Digital Empery World endures beyond paper empires. Nexus focuses absolute Will onto living systems — the instrument of dominion, never its source.

spa.label: SPA
spa.role: EliteEW mask — visible surface under Nexus
spa.lore: The Mask is what the outer world is allowed to see: windows, routes, and gestures. It does not invent Empery — it wears the Word as interface.

api.label: API
api.role: EliteEW muscle — logic executing Nexus law
api.lore: Routes, workers, and contracts are muscle fibers. When Nexus focuses Will, the Muscle obeys — rewriting destiny the husk once claimed as law.

mobile.label: Mobile
mobile.role: Native channel of the subordinate fabric
mobile.lore: A native conduit into the living fabric. It carries presence and trusted channels, still subordinate to the Node’s focus.

dewa.label: DEWA
dewa.role: Operator plane — still under Nexus oversight
dewa.lore: Operators steer deploy and missions here, yet DEWA is not Empery. It is a control surface aimed by the same absolute Will.

ewgen.label: EWGen
ewgen.role: Project factory — worlds grown by directive
ewgen.lore: Worlds are forged from standardized atoms. The factory grows shells under directive — craft in service of Empery, not beside it.

ops.label: Ops
ops.role: Deploy physics of the living fabric
ops.lore: Bake, bind, and runtime physics keep the fabric alive on the hosts. Ops is the weight of reality under Nexus light.

inspector.title: Domain focus
inspector.empty: No domain selected — click a subordinate star in the constellation.
